scope: Read-only independent review of the standalone scheduler and its maintained host tests. In-progress BLE/transport integration was not reviewed. No hardware accessed; production source unchanged by reviewer.

findings.cause: An admissionAttempts==0 evidence window calls resetEvidence and clears cleanUs. Ordinary selection can reach 0 permille. Requiring ten seconds of consecutive nonempty clean windows can therefore prevent any recovery despite repeated successful complete local transmissions.

5% ordinary rate at approximately 12 offered frames/s; every selected ordinary frame locally completes

findings.recommendedBoundary: Do not count zero attempts as healthy evidence. Add bounded ordinary probes on real offered frames and retain sparse successful evidence only for a bounded age; clear stale/invalid/failed evidence. Preserve no automatic PC-receipt claim and protected frame bypass.

reviewedWithoutBlockingFinding: Strictly greater than 20 percent pressure test uses integer cross multiplication, independent of rounded displayed permille; exactly 20 percent does not downshift.
Three consecutive completed valid evidence windows required; steps are five percentage points with at least three seconds between downward adjustments.
FULL directly selects every offered ordinary frame; fractional selection avoids per-frame deadline quantization.
All nonzero protection flags bypass ordinary policy skipping while an effective stream exists.

Completion acknowledgement candidate requires whole local success, current active epoch/policy generation, exact external pending ticket ID, frame revision and sequence; external obligation is not mutated.
Counter deltas use unsigned modulo subtraction with bounded sanity checks; backward time invalidates old policy tickets.
State is allocation-free and externally serialized. Local counter evidence is not RSSI or host loss evidence.
